improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating what Gideon offers and the free trial opportunity. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. The copy focuses on key differentiators (Claude-powered, trade and business focus, free searches) without making unverified claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose (AI assistant for trade and business), building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while emphasizing the risk-free trial with 'no card required' to reduce friction and boost conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've completed your free searches, you'll be invited to join as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose monthly or annual billing—annual saves you 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the primary conversion moment visitors will encounter. It turns the paywall into a value proposition by clearly explaining what they gain as members, states pricing transparently to build trust, and highlights the annual savings incentive to encourage longer commitment.
